cause: ForgeOfHeroesScenarioTest imports kotlinx.serialization.json.Json but the era scenario test module did not declare the pinned kotlinx-serialization-json dependency. The first stage compiled and passed the commander and projection tests. The second stage stopped at test compilation before the ten exact-card cases ran.
correction: Add testImplementation(libs.kotlinxSerialization) only to mtg-sets/2017-2022/tests/build.gradle.kts and include that build file in the existing targeted push path filter. No card or test expectation changes.

cases.name: IsCommander projection matches designated cards of either controller and not same-name copies
IsTapped matches only tapped permanents
IsUntapped matches only untapped permanents
IsAttacking matches only creatures with AttackingComponent
IsBlocking matches only creatures with BlockingComponent
IsBlocked matches attackers that have at least one declared blocker
IsUnblocked matches attackers with no blockers and excludes non-attackers
EnteredThisTurn matches only entities with EnteredThisTurnComponent
WasDealtDamageThisTurn matches only damaged creatures
HasDealtDamage matches every creature with a marker, whatever turn it was stamped
HasDealtDamage(thisTurnOnly) matches only creatures whose marker names the current turn
HasDealtCombatDamageToPlayer matches only creatures that dealt combat damage to a player
IsFaceDown matches only face-down permanents
IsFaceUp matches only face-up permanents
HasMorphAbility matches creatures flagged with morph
ReceivedCounterThisTurn with no narrowing matches any permanent with a recorded placement
ReceivedCounterThisTurn scoped to +1/+1 ignores other counter kinds
ReceivedCounterThisTurn with placedByController ignores counters an opponent put on
ReceivedCounterThisTurn still matches after the counters themselves are gone
ReceivedCounterThisTurn narrowed by kind does not match a bare marker
HasAnyCounter matches any creature with at least one counter of any type
HasCounter(LOYALTY) matches only creatures with that specific counter type
HasCounter("+1/+1") matches creatures with +1/+1 counters — shorthand form
HasCounter("-1/-1") matches creatures with -1/-1 counters — shorthand form
HasCounter with unknown counter type string matches nothing (no accidental fallback)
HasGreatestPower matches the highest-power creature the source's controller controls
HasGreatestPower allows ties — multiple creatures can share the greatest power
IsEquipped matches only creatures with at least one Equipment attached
Or matches entities that satisfy any sub-predicate
And matches entities that satisfy every sub-predicate
Not inverts its sub-predicate
CouldNotHaveAttackedThisTurn spares every creature the nonactive player controls
CouldNotHaveAttackedThisTurn spares everyone when no Declare Attackers Step happened
CouldNotHaveAttackedThisTurn spares a summoning-sick creature but not its neighbour
CouldNotHaveAttackedThisTurn reads the projected controller, not the base one
CouldNotHaveAttackedThisTurn spares a creature a projected effect stopped from attacking
